finding: Agent workflow state is not durably persisted across a process restart in the reviewed architecture boundary.
expected: A restart should allow the workflow state to be recovered when durable persistence is required.
observed: Workflow state was present before restart but was unavailable from the new process boundary.
impact: A process interruption can require the workflow to restart from lost in-memory state unless an external durable state mechanism is introduced.
reproduction: Create AgentState, save it to the in-memory boundary, replace the boundary with a new instance, and attempt to load the previous state.
